name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching-Set Size of the Three-Code Class
proof: The three-concept subfamily itself has minimum projected teaching-set size two, so the monotonic maximum is at least two.  No subfamily has more than three distinct traces, and a target trace among at most three traces is always distinguished by at most two coordinates in any projection.  Hence every subfamily has minimum projected teaching-set size at most two, and the maximum is exactly two.
